Contrôle : ajouter au groupe iam: Check: add to the IAM group
Enregistrer la réponse au dossier: Record the response on the case
Noter l'incident au dossier: Record the incident on the case
Corriger la fiche selon le commentaire d: Correct the record according to the manager's comment, then save: the request goes back for approval.
Le profil de poste demande des accès éte: The job profile requires extended access. Choose the IAM group to grant (DEVELOPPEURS or DIRECTION), or STANDARD to keep the default groups. This choice, not the profile on the record, sets the group.
Un appel à une application a échoué (cha: A call to an application failed (« Last technical incident » field of the record). Fix the cause in the application, then REESSAYER; or ABANDONNER: what was created in the IAM and the HR system is deleted and the request is closed.
Vérifier la fiche du collaborateur. APPR: Check the new hire's record. APPROUVER starts the creation in the HR system, the IAM and the ITSM; CORRIGER sends the record back to HR with your comment; REFUSER closes the request without creating anything.
